law: Correspondence names semantic facets and host-owned operations; projection names placement. Residue is preserved instead of forcing equivalence.

residue: FIELD route semantics and navigation graph remain host-specific
mappings.complement: route/focus source -> projection: route identity, safe address and crossing survive; session focus/navigation state is not carried back. projection -> source: no write path (a view cannot increase authority).

mappings.canonical_truth: one source cursor over text/JSON structure

facets.FOCUS: current addressed unit and char anchor
facets.WITNESS: focus metadata / structure markers / optional pulse+glyph witnesses

residue: segmentation, language, RSVP scheduler and voice remain READFIELD-specific
mappings.complement: source text/JSON + cursor -> projection: the addressed unit and char anchor survive; segmentation, language, RSVP scheduler and voice are dropped. projection -> source: seek/scale are VIEW state only, no write-back.

facets.OPERATE: SELECT / ALIGN / COMPOSE / PROPAGATE; action toolglass only when declared

residue: domain-specific parser/graph semantics and lens descriptors remain Lens-owned
mappings.complement: object graph + LensState -> projection: selected identity and stack order survive; domain parser/graph semantics and lens descriptors are dropped. projection -> source: no mutation (typed admissibility only).

mappings.canonical_truth: session-local active-object pointer only; domain truth stays in LISTEN/SET/READFIELD/LIVE

facets.FRAME: support map + local vault / set context

residue: does not own raw media, text reader state, set authorship, or LIVE world state
mappings.complement: active-object pointer -> projection: kind/support/route survive; the pointer never becomes domain truth. projection -> source: no write-back (raw media, reader state, set authorship and LIVE world state stay with their own hosts).

mappings.canonical_truth: exact audio identity + AUDIO MAP + source-addressed pins
mappings.complement: audio identity + AUDIO MAP + pins -> projection: exact identity and source-addressed pins survive; decode, features and playback clock are dropped. projection -> source: no write-back.

mappings.canonical_truth: ordered exact source references + weight/seam authorship

facets.WITNESS: encoded set preview / exact member refs

residue: composition authority is SET-owned; raw media is not stored in set state
mappings.complement: ordered source refs + weight/seam authorship -> projection: order and exact refs survive; raw media is neither stored nor projected back. projection -> source: composition authority stays SET-owned; no projection becomes a source store.

mappings.canonical_truth: embodied ride/world state over exact source timing; authored SET traversal enters LIVE through the unified dual-clock RIDE state while SET retains composition/seam authority

facets.FRAME: ride profile / world / section / terrain context

residue: SET-wide LIVE fusion is implemented; direct 2–3-source phone validation remains a WAITING_ON_HUMAN gate
world/game mechanics remain LIVE-specific and are not generic projections
mappings.complement: embodied ride/world state over exact source timing -> projection: sourceTime/journeyTime and seam identity survive; world/game mechanics are dropped. projection -> source: no write-back (SET keeps composition/seam authority; phone validation stays a human gate).
commutes_claimed: PROJECT(seam op CUT/DISSOLVE/CARRY/RESET/RETURN) = VIEW_SEAM_OP(PROJECT) over the unified dual-clock RIDE state

mappings.canonical_truth: visible structural DOM + typed seams/cassette structure

facets.FRAME: hierarchy / typed seams / ports / material bindings
facets.OPERATE: MARK / FOLD / ENTER / BACK / DISSOLVE / RUN

residue: ROOM FOLD may be a canonical structural operation, not merely a projection; split FOLD_VIEW from FOLD_OP
mappings.complement: structural #program DOM + typed seams -> projection: block order, cassette structure and typed seams survive; FOLD may be a canonical structural operation rather than a view (FOLD_VIEW vs FOLD_OP split stays open). projection -> source: no write-back.

mappings.canonical_truth: typed state aperture + operator/frame transaction state
residue: physical consequence and operator typing remain AXIAL/host-specific
mappings.complement: typed state aperture + operator/frame transaction state -> projection: aperture and frame typing survive; physical consequence and operator typing are dropped. projection -> source: no write-back (orientation may not actuate).

mappings.canonical_truth: native form controls and their host authority

scale_correspondence.room: left wall is one legal placement for FOCUS_INPUT
scale_correspondence.physical: left panel only through measured physical binding

residue: submit/effects remain host-owned; placement never grants authority
mappings.complement: native form control value -> projection: object id and semantic facet survive; placement/visibility never grants authority. projection -> source: submit and effects remain host-owned (a view may not commit).
commutes_claimed: PROJECT(EDIT(host)) = VIEW_EDIT(PROJECT(host)) for the FOCUS_INPUT value edit

mappings.canonical_truth: evidence-grounded artifacts + claims + conflicts + UNKNOWN + anti-merge holds

facets.OPERATE: candidate disposition/comparison only; read-only adapter grants no migration authority

residue: promotion, merge and deletion remain MIGRATION/FIELD INTAKE authority
mappings.complement: evidence-grounded artifacts + claims -> projection: exact refs, conflicts, UNKNOWN and anti-merge holds survive; prose-only synthesis is dropped. projection -> source: promotion/merge/deletion stay MIGRATION/FIELD INTAKE authority; packets are append-only and superseded, never mutated.

mappings.canonical_truth: measured physical object/assembly state supplied by a future physical host

facets.OPERATE: rotate / slide / clamp / cut / drill / energize only with explicit effect authority

residue: rendered geometry is never physical proof; load/fit/tolerance/safety require measured evidence
mappings.complement: measured physical object/assembly state -> projection: addressed identity, declared controls and proposed projections survive; dimensions, tolerances, fit, load and safety are dropped. projection -> source: no write-back - rendered geometry is never physical proof and fit requires measured evidence.

mappings.canonical_truth: exact browser-local item identity + native procurement lifecycle; shared material phase is derived projection only

facets.SOURCE: exact selected item (id / kind need|thing / label / source URL / observed evidence)
facets.FRAME: native lifecycle state + six-part purchase gate + lane; derived material phase NEED..CLOSED
facets.FOCUS: selected item at its phase aperture (NEED / VERIFY / DECIDE / RECEIVE / PROVE / SYSTEM / HISTORY)
facets.OPERATE: native transitions FIND / VERIFY / ACQUIRE / RECEIVE / PROVE / CLOSE + <=3 bounded moves (AGENT_PACKET / LOOTER / HOUSE_FIT / OPEN_SOURCE / DAYLINE); HOST_NATIVE_ONLY
facets.WITNESS: six-part purchase-gate evidence + phase/state summary + source-owned evidenceRefs
facets.RETURN: exact item address /shopping/#<id> + RETURN TO SHOPPING

residue: detailed lifecycle values and ledger fields remain host-owned; the shared phase never mutates native state
purchase, seller contact, money movement and adoption remain human/evidence-gated; no projection or carrier can act
mappings.complement: browser-local item identity + native procurement lifecycle -> projection: exact item identity and a derived material phase survive; detailed lifecycle values and ledger fields are dropped. projection -> source: no write-back - purchase, seller contact, money movement and adoption stay human/evidence-gated; the shared phase never mutates native state.
commutes_claimed: native lifecycle -> derived shared material phase (the phase never mutates native state)

mappings.canonical_truth: session-local DayState workfield holding one object; exact source link + RETURN carried; the adapter is read-only (VIEW)

facets.SOURCE: held object + exact source link (sourceLink.route / inherited handoff envelope)
facets.FRAME: owner / DayState workfield context + projection presentation (PAGE / FOVEA / LINE / RING)
facets.FOCUS: one held object (title) at aperture WORK
facets.OPERATE: native moves projected as HOLD / TURN / RELEASE without renaming handlers; DAYLINE_NATIVE_EFFECTS_ONLY
facets.WITNESS: witness RECORDED / OPEN + afterChecksum / eventIds / return class (WORLD_DELTA / ORIENTATION_SNAPSHOT)
facets.RETURN: exact return_to + OFFER_ONLY source return; the native source accepts, rejects, defers or ignores

residue: scheduling, execution slot, urgency and local DayState mutation remain Dayline-native; the read-only adapter adds no effect authority
source acceptance authority stays with the source host; Dayline never promotes source state
mappings.complement: session-local DayState workfield holding one object -> projection: the held object, exact source link and RETURN survive (VIEW only); scheduling, execution slot and urgency are dropped. projection -> source: read-only - the adapter adds no effect authority and Dayline never promotes source state.
commutes_claimed: FIELD -> DAYLINE continuity: PROJECT(focus/projection witness) = VIEW_OP(PROJECT) with no authority increase

mappings.canonical_truth: ephemeral authority-free continuation frame across host boundaries; object identity stays stable while focus / projection / witness may change; RETURN explicit

facets.SOURCE: stable object identity (id / owner / address / contract) + sourceRefs
facets.FRAME: projection + lineage (host / name / channels / residue; parentFrameId / handoffId): the declared cut of a continuation
facets.FOCUS: current focus id / label / address / aperture
facets.OPERATE: next typed moves (VIEW / NAVIGATION / EDIT / EFFECT / OFFER; HOLD / TURN / RELEASE / TRACE / RETURN) with pre-commit forecast (effect / authority / commit / sourceMutation / reversibility); dispatch HOST_NATIVE_ONLY - the carrier executes nothing
facets.WITNESS: witness class UNPROVED / OBSERVED / EVIDENCE / RETURN + evidenceRefs; stable frameId hash over object / focus / return / projection
facets.RETURN: exact return address / owner / label; sameObject identity check across frames

residue: the carrier carries no domain payload, semantics or effects; authority is fixed NONE / HANDOFF ONLY
native handoff envelopes remain the domain transport (a recipient may ignore the carrier); frames are session-ephemeral, not canonical history
mappings.complement: stable object identity -> projection: identity, address and focus survive across frames; domain payload, semantics and effects are dropped. projection -> source: nothing - authority is fixed NONE / HANDOFF ONLY and frames are session-ephemeral, not canonical history.
commutes_claimed: sameObject identity across frames; native move -> shared verb classification at VIEW authority
